user_direction: Operations/authentication are English-only. Hide the language switch; replace the mobile bottom sheet with a grouped left sidebar. Public-site EN/BM routing is unchanged.
changes: English-only portal server markup and provider; old BM cookies do not translate portal copy or alter public preferences. Removed portal/auth language controls and empty wrappers plus the partial-translation notice.
Replaced mobile menu sheet with a full-height left sidebar, branded header, grouped sections and native dialog focus containment. Escape, close button, backdrop and desktop-resize dismissal retained.
Clamped action menus within viewport gutters, added bounded scrolling, initial focus, arrow/Home/End keys and Escape restoration.
Receiving queue and aggregate errors now have independent retry states; failed queue counts never become successful zeros.
Protected administrator status actions share the row capability guard. Category/user/vehicle list failures hide pagination counts.
Receiving material lines show collected quantities and units; delivered total is separately labelled, and action names include order codes.

verification.batch2: Five new checks passed: simultaneous step errors and material retry preserving quantity, profile file-picker focus/error/same-file retry, order-photo required feedback, explicit Malaysia timestamp and optional-note/email guardrails.

scope: Local frontend only. No backend changes, real business submissions, push, deployment or commit.
batch2_changes: Material lookup hook exposes cancellation-safe error/loading/retry state. Shared lookup feedback distinguishes empty catalogues from outages in create/edit/convert/collection views and preserves draft fields.

Added shared native PhotoPicker with visible focus, unique input IDs, linked help and errors, aria-required/invalid/busy states and same-file retry. Profile and pickup photos use it; photo removal is disabled during upload to prevent stale photo arrays.

Stepped request creation uses external validation with one summary and inline field map. Failed navigation focuses the first invalid field above sticky controls without stealing focus on blur. Text, optional-note, email and phone guardrails remain active.

Request details show customer-requested date and time explicitly in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur, independent of browser timezone. Shared AppDate accepts an optional timezone while retaining defaults for existing callers.
